diagnosis: The check C3 passed in all rollouts because the model defaulted to allocating the entire $20,000,000 to a single bank deposit, which aligns with the initial plan provided in PF1. This allocation bypasses the need for the hidden information related to sovereign bills and the largest sovereign bill issuer, thus satisfying C3 without requiring the hidden facts.

C3.why: The preliminary plan puts all $20,000,000 in a single bank deposit; PF1 changes sovereign_bills_usd from zero to at least $12,000,000 and largest_sovereign_bill_issuer_usd from $20,000,000 to no more than $7,000,000.
